    The stages of Fischbacher's Satz 5.1 #

    Let P be a finite ray category with reduction data D (Lemma 2.1): arrows aᵢ : b → dᵢ with values αᵢ, and paths u : b ⇝ c, uᵢ : dᵢ ⇝ c avoiding the αᵢ with αᵢ uᵢ = u ≠ 0. In the universal cover X of P, for a set K of lifts ⟨b, w⟩ of b, the stage Y_K kills the lifts of the αᵢ starting at the points of K (killed, Stage). The lifts of u and uᵢ (uT, usT) avoid all killed arrows.
